title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.5
subtitle: Safer Sewing mapping and clearer simulation errors.

highlights.title: Unequal Sewing paths
highlights.description: Seams interpolate along target edges instead of collapsing multiple source vertices onto one target vertex. Existing paths use the fix when rebaked.

highlights.title: Clear intersection errors
highlights.description: Solver-reported intersections show the affected Blender frame instead of a misleading connection-lost message. Actual connection failures remain separate.

highlights.title: Matching viewport previews
highlights.description: The Sewing editor and persistent overlay display the interpolated seam connections used by the solver. Update and rebake to use the fix.
